contract.intended_consumer: Brian and his coding agents operating governed project lanes
contract.outcome: Produce deterministic source-bound blocker decisions that continue ready work, isolate local collisions, and fail closed on incomplete evidence.

canonical_journey.starting_state: An agent reports a blocker while one revision-bound plan graph and canonical claim snapshot describe the available work.
canonical_journey.input: The exact native session, canonical claim binding, graph path and digest, blocker request, and any canonical delivery evidence.
canonical_journey.action: Recompute the ready queue from source bytes and emit one diagnostic disposition without mutating ownership.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Ready alternatives continue, verified local collisions wait, complete blockers are diagnosed, and unavailable evidence returns control unverified.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: A fabricated session, project scope, graph, claim, path, mailbox state, or incomplete schema can create a verified decision or hide ready work.

receipts.summary: The exact claimed session can now derive both-sign blocker dispositions from canonical graph and claim evidence without authorizing mutation.
